griidc-adt-speed-core-haskell.citation: DUACS (2025), Gridded absolute dynamic topography – Gulf subset – daily time series 1993–2019, GRIIDC.
griidc-adt-speed-core-haskell.access: Immutable original NetCDF SHA-verified and processed only in the cloud on one low-priority CPU, one daily slice. Two recovered NOAA chart images and the cloud contour diagnostic actually reviewed. Nineteen geometry/speed-core tests passed. Qualified source-case core and numerical range only; no physical outer boundary or seasonal envelope.

records.source_locator: Original DUACS daily ADT August 1, 1999; NOAA/AOML Mission Summary 990803H by P. Black, linked TOPEX/ERS-2 Analysis Aug 1 1999 chart recovered through Internet Archive capture 20041117165053; plotted survey waypoint 6.
records.definition: Spherical area inside the maximum circum-averaged geostrophic-speed contour.
records.scope: OSW-derived speed-core diagnostic for the northeastern named survey feature. Physical registry crosswalk unverified; no neighboring or parent/secondary values inherited.
records.qualification: Maximum perimeter-averaged geostrophic speed selects a core contour. Fixed 0.005/0.0025 m level steps pass convergence gates; their range plus outward rounding is numerical only, not physical uncertainty or an annual range. Mapping, MDT and gradient/interpolation errors remain unquantified; sampling/support and search radius are not effective resolution or positional accuracy. Core radius is not outer radius; bounding arcs are not principal width; mean geostrophic speed is not a local current maximum or direct AXCP observation. Survey waypoint proxy, not an observed center. Archived chart dated August 1, August 3 mission naming and registry May separation remain separate. No physical continuity, full footprint, state containment, ranking, volume, playback or exact lifetime inferred.
